svg.title: Warden at a glance
svg.desc: Eight measured results. Against PM2: 1.3 times the requests per second, 3.5 times lower p99, no requests lost in a rolling restart, 6.5 times faster crash recovery with a hot standby, 60 times faster list, 3.4 times less manager memory. Against nginx: 27 percent less CPU per request on a 1.5 KB page, and 7 to 177 times less CPU than nginx compressing on the fly.

svg.text: Measured on one small VM: PM2 6.0.14 on 2026-10-01, nginx 1.24 on 2026-10-03.
